name: kneeling chest clam
description: A kneeling chest opener that moves the elbows from in front of the face out to the sides.
instructions: Kneel upright and rest your fingers lightly behind your head.
Start with your elbows pointing forward.
Open your elbows out and slightly back as far as is comfortable while gently drawing your shoulder blades together.
Breathe steadily, then bring the elbows forward and repeat.
